review:
A classic 3x5 with 10 lines and a twist: Fire Strike symbols pay directly whenever six or more land anywhere, no lines needed.

The big target is filling the screen with 15 wild Fire Strike symbols for a jackpot of up to 25,000x the bet. No free spins, no complicated modifiers – just one big thing to chase, old-school fruit machine style. 96.5% RTP.
